event.description:
Nationals is an invite-only tournament in which the top placing players will then be invited directly into the World Championships in Las Vegas, NV.
•	Oceania & Southeast Asia Nationals: 4 Championship Slots Each
•	Day 1: 6 rounds swiss format
•	Day 2: Top 16, 4 rounds swiss format + Top 4 Single Elimination.
